title: Guest Towel Holder Countertop Stand 16.3-Inch Solid Brass - Carolina Collection | Sea Foam Green | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom vanity with a guest towel holder that keeps hand towels and washcloths within easy reach, featuring a stable, freestanding countertop design crafted from solid brass in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces.

  • Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Heavy base helps prevent tipping on the countertop
  • Felt pad helps protect countertop surfaces from scratches
  • Coordinates with the Carolina collection for a cohesive look

Specs

  • Category: Guest towel holders (freestanding towel stand)
  • Mounting type: Countertop
  • Dimensions: 16.3-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W x 14-Inch H
  • Weight capacity: 20 lb
  • Product weight: 5.6 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Freestanding towel holder
  • Multiple designer finishes available
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Designed to complement transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories.
